_comment: Evidence-backed prose claims that are NOT reducible to a single capability status (those live in capabilities.json). Each claim carries its evidence and the date it was last verified, so the claim visibly ages until re-verified. There is deliberately no automated verifier for these — they are a human review item at release. See docs/adr/0002-capabilities-manifest.md.

claims.claim: Governance — the same identity, policy and audit — has been demonstrated across ADK, LangChain and OpenAI adapters: one governance layer, not one per framework.
evidence: forge-agents/harness/phase1e_adk_conformance.py (live: governance survives the framework swap to ADK)
claims.verified_note: The adapter code exists and is unit-tested. A dated PASSING run of the phase1e LIVE conformance harnesses (against the europe substrate + europe operator KMS key) is pending — see the Item-2 VPC job. Until that artifact is stored and linked here, date_last_verified stays null and the claim must be read as 'implemented, live-run artifact pending', not 'freshly re-verified'.
